name: RollingPriceToggle
job: A billing or option toggle whose prices roll like odometer digits and whose included-features list reorders to match the choice
visitor_action: click/tap or arrow keys to switch options
owner_settings: Options (label, price, billing period, saving badge text, included features one per line)
mobile: toggle full width above the price block
motion: thumb slides with spring, digits roll to new values, features slide and fade (reduced-motion: instant swap)
art_direction: Savings bank: fresh mint-white card, deep pine toggle thumb, tabular figures in dark slate, small gold saving badge
